payload.claim: The `timed_out` branch — added specifically so a fired wall/idle bound on the critic's `git apply` is not misread as an agent-caused rejection (the `error` != `fail` rule) — is never exercised: no test constructs a `Completed` with `timed_out=True`, so both the default stub and `_stub_critic_apply`'s override always leave it False. Widening the check to `if applied.timed_out and False:` keeps every apply/binary/success witness green, so a later edit that reintroduces the exit-124-as-refusal bug this branch guards against would go unnoticed by the suite.
